tagline: IKEv2 se keys agree karo, phir har IP packet ko ESP se encrypt karo.
description: IPsec poore IP packets ko protect karta hai. IKEv2 pehle crypto par agree karta hai, Diffie-Hellman keys badalta hai aur prove karta hai ki har side kaun hai. Uske baad ESP asli traffic carry karta hai, encrypted aur numbered, aur beech mein NAT ho to UDP 4500 mein wrapped.

normal.name: Remote worker office se connect hota hai
normal.summary: Laptop ghar ke NAT ke peeche se IKEv2 session banata hai, phir ESP ke zariye file server tak pahunchta hai.

steps.title: IKE_SA_INIT request
steps.desc: Crypto offer karo, public key aur nonce bhejo
steps.detail: Laptop port 500 par ek UDP packet se shuru karta hai. Isme teen key payloads hain: SA (jo crypto woh accept karega), KE (uski Curve25519 public key) aur Nonce (fresh random bytes). Do Notify payloads uske apne address aur port ke hashes carry karte hain, taaki gateway bata sake ki NAT ne unhe rewrite kiya ya nahi.

steps.title: IKE_SA_INIT response
steps.desc: Gateway crypto chunta hai aur NAT pakadta hai
steps.detail: Gateway proposal accept karta hai, apni public key aur nonce bhejta hai, aur apna Responder SPI bharta hai. Ab dono sides X25519 se wahi shared secret compute karke keys derive kar sakte hain. Gateway ka NAT hash 198.51.100.7 se bana hai, jo address usne asal mein dekha, isliye laptop ko pata chal jaata hai ki beech mein NAT hai.

quiz.q: NAT hashes match nahi karte. Dono sides ab kya karengi?
options: Haar maan lengi: IPsec NAT cross nahi kar sakta
UDP 4500 par chali jayengi aur ESP ko UDP mein wrap karengi
Phir bhi ESP ko IP protocol 50 ki tarah bhejengi
quiz.why: Plain ESP mein ports nahi hote, isliye ghar ka NAT use track nahi kar sakta. NAT traversal IKE ko port 4500 par le jaata hai aur ESP ko bhi UDP 4500 ke andar daalta hai.

steps.title: IKE_AUTH, encrypted
steps.desc: Identities prove karo aur ESP tunnel set up karo
steps.detail: Ab se IKE SK payload ke andar encrypted hai aur UDP 4500 par chalta hai, isliye 4-byte non-ESP marker se shuru hota hai. Andar chhupe hain laptop ki identity, certificate aur AUTH signature, inner address ki request, aur traffic selectors ke saath ESP proposal. Gateway apne certificate aur AUTH ke saath jawab deta hai, laptop ko 10.99.0.7 deta hai aur ek ESP SPI chunta hai.
facts: IDi, CERT, AUTH, CP, SA, TSi, TSr

quiz.q: Yeh IKE message chaar zero bytes se kyun shuru hota hai?
options: Shared port 4500 par batane ke liye ki yeh IKE hai, ESP nahi
quiz.why: IKE aur ESP UDP 4500 share karte hain. ESP non-zero SPI se shuru hota hai, isliye chaar zero bytes packet ko IKE mark karte hain.

steps.title: ESP: traffic bahar jaata hai
steps.desc: Poora IP packet, UDP 4500 ke andar encrypted
steps.detail: Laptop 10.20.0.15 par file share kholna chahta hai. Woh 10.99.0.7 se normal packet banata hai, use poora AES-GCM se encrypt karta hai, aur gateway ke SPI aur sequence number 1 ke saath ESP header jodta hai. Gateway use decrypt karke plain packet office ke andar forward karta hai.

quiz.q: Coffee-shop mein baitha eavesdropper is packet se kya seekh sakta hai?
options: Jo file name khul rahi hai
Sirf outer addresses, ports, SPI aur size
Kuch bhi nahi, size bhi nahi
quiz.why: Inner packet encrypted hai. Outer IP aur UDP headers, SPI, sequence number aur length phir bhi dikhte hain.

steps.title: Reply aur keepalive
steps.desc: Traffic wapas, aur NAT khula rakhne ke liye chhota packet
steps.detail: File server ka answer gateway laptop ke SPI se encrypt karke UDP 4500 par wapas bhejta hai. Jab tunnel shaant hota hai, laptop har 20 seconds mein ek-byte NAT-keepalive (0xFF) bhejta hai taaki ghar ka router port mapping na bhoole.

outro.title: Tunnel chal raha hai
outro.text: IKEv2 ke do round trips ne crypto par agree kiya, keys badli, dono identities prove ki aur ESP security associations ki ek jodi banayi. Ab office ka har packet UDP 4500 ke andar encrypted ESP ki tarah travel karta hai, isliye woh ghar ke NAT se nikal jaata hai.

no-proposal.name: Proposal mismatch
no-proposal.summary: Purana client sirf 3DES aur kamzor DH group offer karta hai; gateway NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN se mana kar deta hai.

steps.title: Purane zamane ka offer
steps.detail: Is laptop ka config kisi purani guide se copy kiya hua hai. Uska ekmatra proposal 3DES encryption, HMAC-SHA1-96 integrity, SHA-1 PRF aur DH group 2 (1024-bit MODP) hai. Isliye uska KE payload 32 ki jagah 128 bytes lamba hai.

steps.title: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN
steps.desc: Gateway kuch bhi accept nahi karta
steps.detail: Gateway sirf Curve25519 ya strong MODP groups ke saath AES-GCM allow karta hai, isliye offer mein kuch match nahi karta. Woh ek hi Notify payload, type 14 NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN, se jawab deta hai aur koi state nahi rakhta. Fix client par hai: uski proposal list update karo, gateway ko kamzor mat banao.

quiz.q: Gateway ke reply mein kaunse payloads honge?
options: Apni choice ke saath SA, KE aur Nonce
Kuch nahi; woh chup rehta hai
quiz.why: Koi acceptable proposal na ho to negotiate karne ko kuch nahi bachta, isliye reply ek akela error Notify hota hai.

outro.title: Pehle message par hi refuse
outro.text: Dono IKE peers ke paas kam se kam ek poora algorithms ka set common hona chahiye. Na ho to responder NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN bhejta hai aur kuch set up nahi hota. Dono sides ke logs aksar offered aur allowed transforms list karte hain, jisse yeh theek karna aasan hota hai.
